# opnsense_interfaces_loopback (Data Source)

Loopback devices (**Interfaces ▸ Devices ▸ Loopback**). The device is `lo<device_id>`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the loopback.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the loopback.
- `device` (String) Device name, `lo<device_id>`.
- `device_id` (Number) Number of the device (`lo<device_id>`). Assigned by OPNsense when unset.
